nodes.label: Category creation: 'Visual Options' / 'Options You Can See' — name a new shelf instead of fighting on trading-education
nodes.rationale: The trading-education software market is ~$1.35B and a knife-fight; the category phrase travels (hero, TikTok, broker deck) but is a marketing frame, not a moat — the real moat is SEBI-compliant paper-only positioning, the India F&O wedge, and iteration speed.

nodes.label: Killed the $59 Power tier at launch: two paid tiers (Plus $19 / Pro $39), Power deferred to Phase 2 once data is real
nodes.rationale: Three price points means three value stories for a 3-person team, and Power's headline '27-bot consensus' feature is unverified in the shipped hero and depends on a live data feed that doesn't exist — do not market a bot ensemble we can't demo.

nodes.label: Four physical trust signals: paper-only by default, no signals ever, 'Source: Mock' on-screen honesty, regulator-aligned banners
nodes.rationale: The category default is the rented-Lamborghini Telegram guru; being the visible structural opposite — including labeling synthetic numbers on screen — converts the biggest weakness (mock/lagged data) into the loudest trust proof.

hyperedges.label: 'Source: Mock' honest-fallback disclosure as a deliberate trust and compliance feature: implemented as the statusMetric on every AI bot card, named a physical trust signal by Brand, a compliance-by-design asset by the research brief, and a keep-proprietary layer by the AI roadmap
